This test checks the quick fix for undefined functions, including valid
parameter names for golang/go#81810.

Cases are grouped by how names and types are inferred:
  - arguments/ident: names reused from argument identifiers.
  - arguments/type: names derived from argument types.
  - returns: result types inferred from the surrounding context.

-- arguments/ident/consecutive.go --
package ident

func consecutiveParams() {
	var s string
	undefinedConsecutiveParams(s, s) //@quickfix("undefinedConsecutiveParams", re"(undeclared|undefined)", consecutive)
}
-- @consecutive/arguments/ident/consecutive.go --
@@ -7 +7,4 @@
+
+func undefinedConsecutiveParams(s1, s2 string) {
+	panic("unimplemented")
+}
